_what: Verbatim public statements by Danish ministries, ministers, parties, NGOs and industry bodies justifying or contesting the December 2025 nitrogen agreement (kvælstofaftalen, 3 Dec 2025), the wider Grøn Trepart / 'Aftale om Implementering af et Grønt Danmark' (18 Nov 2024), and the implementing law L5 (gødskningsloven, passed 3 Sep 2026, 119–34). Collected to make it possible to check what was actually asserted about (a) the nitrogen figures, (b) the state of the sea, (c) agriculture's share, and (d) what the policy will achieve — against what the underlying documents say those figures are.
_rule: Every 'quote_da' is the source's own Danish wording, copied character-for-character from the page or PDF cited in 'source_url'. Paraphrase is NEVER presented as quotation: where an entry is a paraphrase it carries "verbatim": false and says so. 'gloss_en' is a translation supplied here and is not a quotation of anything. Elisions inside a quote are marked '[...]'. Where a source's own typography or spelling is odd, it is left as found and flagged in 'note'. Nothing in this file is invented; if a wording could not be verified it is not here.
_collected_by: manual web capture (curl + text extraction) of the cited pages; no quote is reconstructed from memory

_classes.number_claim: asserts a figure (tonnage, share, fraction of indsatsbehov)
_classes.causal_claim: asserts that nitrogen causes an outcome, or that the policy will cause an outcome
_classes.state_claim: asserts the condition of the sea (iltsvind, dead seabed, fish absence)
_classes.certainty_claim: asserts that the scientific/technical basis is settled or, conversely, that it is not
_classes.necessity_claim: asserts the policy is required — by the EU, by law, or by circumstance

_flags.estimator_treated_as_estimand: a modelled quantity (retention share, source apportionment, maximum allowable input) is stated as if it were measured
_flags.uncertainty_acknowledged: the speaker states a limit on what the models can support
_flags.limitation_stated: the speaker limits the policy claim, without addressing model uncertainty
_flags.cited_as_settled_science: invoked to close discussion of the technical basis
_flags.eu_obligation_asserted: asserts that EU law leaves no discretion
_flags.hedged_in_source: the technical document hedges where public statements do not
_flags.contests_model_basis: disputes that the model outputs can bear the regulatory weight placed on them
_flags.unqualified_causal_chain: nitrogen to oxygen depletion asserted with no other driver mentioned
_flags.denominator_variant: supplies one of the mutually inconsistent indsatsbehov totals

_caveats: Several statements collected here post-date December 2025. They are included because they justify the same policy: the June 2026 completion of the model and the August–September 2026 passage of L5 are the same agreement being defended.

'Indsatsbehov' is not measured. It is target load (MAI, from DHI/AU marine models) subtracted from projected 2027 baseline load (from catchment models). The three denominators encountered in these sources are 12,776 t, 13,780 t and 14,800 t — the 'two thirds' fraction is quoted with none of them attached.

The 69.6 % agricultural share is a modelled residual, not a measurement: natural background (22.1 %) is a model output and reported point sources are subtracted, with the remainder routed through the modelled retention map. Entries carrying the flag 'estimator_treated_as_estimand' state it as a plain fact.
Altinget entries were captured above a paywall; only headline, standfirst and pull-quote text was verifiable, and those entries say so.

No verbatim Folketinget floor transcript could be retrieved: ft.dk/BEH1-15/forhandling.htm and the folketingstidende.dk equivalent render the debate text via JavaScript, and the ripdf PDF path returns 403 behind Cloudflare. Chamber quotations here are therefore taken from press renderings (TV 2, Ritzau, Maskinbladet, Effektivt Landbrug, Kristeligt Dagblad) and are quotations of those renderings.

Party positions were also sought on the parties' own websites; almost no party published a standalone press release on the 3 December 2025 agreement, so several party positions rest on chamber reporting and on a pre-election questionnaire (DM Bio, March 2026).

statements.speaker: Ministeriet for Grøn Trepart (pressemeddelelse, ingen navngiven taler)
statements.quote_da: Ny aftale er den mest ambitiøse og bindende reduktion af kvælstofudledninger i Danmark nogensinde og leverer to tredjedele af det samlede indsatsbehov.
statements.gloss_en: New agreement is the most ambitious and binding reduction of nitrogen discharges in Denmark ever and delivers two thirds of the total indsatsbehov.
statements.note: 'Indsatsbehov' is a modelled quantity (MAI minus projected baseline load). The fraction is stated without an interval.

statements.speaker: Ministeriet for Grøn Trepart (pressemeddelelse)
statements.quote_da: Sammenlagt skønnes kvælstofreguleringen og den aftalte spildevandsindsats at reducere med ca. 10.100 ton kvælstof, hvilket er mere end to tredjedele af det samlede indsatsbehov for at leve op til vandrammedirektivets mål for de danske kystvande. Det er et helt afgørende skridt for at genskabe livet i havet.
statements.gloss_en: Combined, the nitrogen regulation and the agreed wastewater effort are estimated to reduce by approx. 10,100 tonnes of nitrogen, which is more than two thirds of the total indsatsbehov for meeting the Water Framework Directive's targets for Danish coastal waters. It is an absolutely decisive step towards recreating life in the sea.
statements.note: 'Skønnes' (is estimated) is retained for the tonnage but dropped for the fraction and for the causal step to 'genskabe livet i havet'.

statements.speaker: Ministeriet for Grøn Trepart (pressemeddelelse)
statements.quote_da: Kvælstofkvoterne justeres i takt med, at der kommer nye målinger af, hvor meget kvælstofudledning vandmiljøet kan klare, og i takt med at landmændene omlægger til natur.
statements.gloss_en: The nitrogen quotas are adjusted as new measurements arrive of how much nitrogen discharge the water environment can tolerate, and as farmers convert to nature.
statements.note: 'Hvor meget kvælstofudledning vandmiljøet kan klare' is the modelled maximum allowable input (MAI), produced by the DHI/AU marine models. It is not measured. The sentence describes updates to it as 'nye målinger'.

statements.speaker: Ministeriet for Grøn Trepart (pressemeddelelse)
statements.quote_da: Aftalen vil sikre markant større reduktion i udledningen af kvælstof fra landbruget på ca. 7.900 ton mod 3.500 ton fra den nuværende kvælstofregulering (MR).
statements.gloss_en: The agreement will secure a markedly larger reduction in nitrogen discharge from agriculture of approx. 7,900 tonnes against 3,500 tonnes from the current nitrogen regulation (MR).

statements.speaker: Ministeriet for Grøn Trepart (pressemeddelelse)
statements.quote_da: Aftalen skaber et sikkerhedsnet under den grønne treparts historiske arealomlægningen og viser dermed vejen til et renere og sundere vand i vores fjorde og langs vores kyster i Danmark.
statements.gloss_en: The agreement creates a safety net under the green tripartite's historic land conversion and thereby shows the way to cleaner and healthier water in our fjords and along our coasts in Denmark.
statements.note: Typo 'arealomlaegningen' is in the original.

statements.speaker: Jeppe Bruus
statements.quote_da: Der har været meget snak om en ny kvælstofregulering i årevis. Nu indfører vi den. Det er en helt nødvendig brik i den grønne trepart. Nødvendig for, at vi kan genoprette livet i de danske farvande. Derfor er jeg rigtig glad for, at aftalepartierne i dag har taget ansvar for, hvordan vi fremover skal indrette kvælstofreguleringen mere målrettet og effektivt til gavn for både naturen og landbruget.
statements.gloss_en: There has been a lot of talk about a new nitrogen regulation for years. Now we are introducing it. It is an absolutely necessary piece in the green tripartite. Necessary so that we can restore life in Danish waters. That is why I am very glad that the agreement parties today have taken responsibility for how we shall arrange nitrogen regulation more targeted and effective, to the benefit of both nature and agriculture.
statements.note: Also carried verbatim by Effektivt Landbrug and Økologisk Nu.

statements.speaker: Jeppe Bruus
statements.quote_da: Det bringer os to tredjedele af vejen. Er vi helt i mål? Nej, det er vi ikke, der er masser af arbejde igen.
statements.gloss_en: It brings us two thirds of the way. Are we all the way there? No, we are not, there is plenty of work left.
statements.note: Limits the claim as to policy coverage. Does not address model uncertainty.

statements.speaker: Jeppe Bruus
statements.quote_da: Hvis du skulle gøre det op til 14.000 tons, skulle du ekspropriere en masse jord. Det har vi ikke hverken midler eller mulighed for. Det ville heller ikke være rimeligt.
statements.gloss_en: If you were to take it up to 14,000 tonnes, you would have to expropriate a lot of land. We have neither the funds nor the possibility for that. Nor would it be reasonable.

statements.speaker: Jeppe Bruus
statements.quote_da: Jeg synes, det er en falliterklæring, at vi ikke allerede for ti år siden har bragt os i en situation, hvor vi kunne leve op til EU's vandrammedirektiv, og jeg synes, det er en falliterklæring, at vandkvaliteten er for dårlig. Derfor er jeg som minister optaget af at gøre noget ved det.
statements.gloss_en: I think it is a declaration of bankruptcy that we did not already ten years ago put ourselves in a situation where we could live up to the EU Water Framework Directive, and I think it is a declaration of bankruptcy that the water quality is too poor. That is why, as minister, I am concerned to do something about it.

statements.speaker: Jeppe Bruus
statements.quote_da: Der har været masser af snak. Det er sket for lidt, og det er hele grundlaget med treparten: At der er sket for lidt i mange år, og nu skal der ske rigtig meget på få år.
statements.gloss_en: There has been plenty of talk. Too little has happened, and that is the whole basis of the tripartite: that too little has happened for many years, and now a great deal must happen in a few years.

statements.speaker: Ritzau (refererende, ikke citat af navngiven person)
statements.quote_da: Forskere vurderer dog, at der er behov for en reduktion på 14.800 ton kvælstof for at få god vandkvalitet igen.
statements.gloss_en: Researchers assess, however, that a reduction of 14,800 tonnes of nitrogen is needed to obtain good water quality again.
statements.note: The denominator against which 'two thirds' is computed in press coverage. Sources in this file give 12,776 t, 13,780 t and 14,800 t.

statements.speaker: Ministeriet for Grøn Trepart (pressemeddelelse)
statements.quote_da: Aftalepartierne er enige om at fastsætte det såkaldte braklægningspunkt, der definerer det maksimale reguleringstryk i de enkelte vandoplande. Det bidrager til, at Danmark kan nå i mål med vandrammedirektivet i 2030.
statements.gloss_en: The agreement parties agree to set the so-called set-aside point, which defines the maximum regulatory pressure in the individual water catchments. This contributes to Denmark being able to reach the Water Framework Directive target in 2030.

statements.speaker: Ministeriet for Grøn Trepart (pressemeddelelse)
statements.quote_da: Den frivillige arealomlægning er hovedmotoren i Den Grønne Trepart, og en ny kvælstofreguleringsmodel er det sikkerhedsnet, der skaber forudsætningerne for, at de danske vandoplande opnår god økologisk tilstand.
statements.gloss_en: The voluntary land conversion is the main engine of the Green Tripartite, and a new nitrogen regulation model is the safety net that creates the preconditions for the Danish water catchments to achieve good ecological status.

statements.speaker: Ministeriet for Natur og Dyrevelfærd (pressemeddelelse)
statements.quote_da: Den nye model ventes med ét hug at fjerne to tredjedele af de udledninger, vi skal have væk for at kunne genoprette det gode og sunde liv under havets overflade.
statements.gloss_en: The new model is expected in one blow to remove two thirds of the discharges we need to get rid of in order to restore the good and healthy life beneath the sea surface.

statements.speaker: Christian Rabjerg Madsen
statements.quote_da: Den nye reguleringsmodel markerer et vendepunkt. Vi løser et problem, som er blevet skabt gennem årtiers politisk svigt, hvor for meget kvælstof på landbrugets marker har ført til iltsvind og ødelagt levesteder for fisk, muslinger og planter. Det her er en kæmpe aftale, som jeg er meget stolt af. Vi skylder både naturen og fremtidige generationer, at vi gør op med forureningen af kvælstof, så vi igen kan se torsken, skrubben og ålen svømme rundt i vandet.
statements.gloss_en: The new regulation model marks a turning point. We are solving a problem created through decades of political failure, where too much nitrogen on agriculture's fields has led to oxygen depletion and destroyed habitats for fish, mussels and plants. This is a huge agreement that I am very proud of. We owe it to both nature and future generations to deal with nitrogen pollution, so that we can again see the cod, the flounder and the eel swimming in the water.
statements.note: Nitrogen -> iltsvind stated without qualification; stratification, weather, atmospheric deposition and transboundary load are not mentioned. The source renders 'Vi' as 'V i' (typographic artefact in the published page); rendered here as 'Vi'.

statements.speaker: Christian Rabjerg Madsen
statements.quote_da: Det er ikke udtryk for et politisk ønske, at det skulle ende på den måde. Og det er ikke et resultat af en forhandling. Det er et resultat af en orientering fra min side om, at det er sådan virkeligheden er.
statements.gloss_en: It is not an expression of a political wish that it should end that way. And it is not the result of a negotiation. It is the result of a briefing from my side that this is how reality is.
statements.note: Effektivt Landbrug quoting the minister's interview with Altinget, on the deferral of the 'kvaelstofhammer' to 2028.

statements.speaker: Christian Rabjerg Madsen
statements.quote_da: Det er helt afgørende, at vi gennemfører reduktionen af kvælstof, for det er forudsætningen for, at vi kan få livet tilbage i vores fjorde.
statements.gloss_en: It is absolutely decisive that we carry out the reduction of nitrogen, because it is the precondition for getting life back in our fjords.

statements.speaker: Christian Rabjerg Madsen
statements.quote_da: Så vil vi jo gå mod en reduktion, som vi ikke vil komme i mål med. Og så vil vi fortsætte med at se Vejle Fjord, hvor nogle af dine kollegaer er dykket i 72 timer uden at finde én eneste fisk eller i hvert fald ganske, ganske få fisk.
statements.gloss_en: Then we would head towards a reduction we would not reach. And then we would continue to see Vejle Fjord, where some of your colleagues dived for 72 hours without finding a single fish, or at any rate very, very few fish.

statements.speaker: Christian Rabjerg Madsen
statements.quote_da: Vi åbner op for værktøjskassen, hvad angår det gode landmandskab, så braklægning er ikke det eneste redskab. Når jeg siger, at vi skal dobbelttjekke det faglige grundlag, er det selvfølgelig med en forhåbning om, at vi kan blive endnu klogere på grøntsager for at se, om vi har det rigtige reguleringstryk, hvad angår grøntsager.
statements.gloss_en: We are opening the toolbox as regards good husbandry, so set-aside is not the only tool. When I say we must double-check the technical basis, it is of course with a hope that we can become even wiser about vegetables, to see whether we have the right regulatory pressure as regards vegetables.
statements.note: A minister conceding the model basis may be wrong, for the area under vegetables (c. 0.3 % of Danish farmland). DR reports in the same piece that he 'anerkender, at grundlaget for at beregne udvaskningen af kvælstof ved produktion af grøntsager er dårligere, end det er for eksempelvis korn og hvede' - that sentence is DR's paraphrase, not his words.

statements.speaker: Christian Rabjerg Madsen
statements.quote_da: Vi har i mange år overtrukket vores konto hos vandmiljøet med massivt iltsvind til følge. Det kan vi ikke blive ved med at gøre, og det er også derfor, at vi skal i gang med at reducere kvælstof for alvor til næste år.
statements.gloss_en: For many years we have overdrawn our account with the water environment, with massive oxygen depletion as a consequence. We cannot keep doing that, and that is also why we must start reducing nitrogen in earnest next year.

statements.speaker: Christian Rabjerg Madsen
statements.quote_da: Vi kan ikke blive ved med at vente på nye rapporter og “second opinions”. Vi skal have livet tilbage i fjordene. Det er en bunden opgave.
statements.gloss_en: We cannot keep waiting for new reports and 'second opinions'. We must have life back in the fjords. It is an obligatory task.
statements.note: Said at L&F's stormøde in Odense. Ritzau via DK Nyt.

statements.speaker: Christian Rabjerg Madsen
statements.quote_da: Det nytter ikke, at vi år efter år producerer, så vi sætter rekord i iltsvind.
statements.gloss_en: It is no good that year after year we produce in such a way that we set records in oxygen depletion.

statements.speaker: Christian Rabjerg Madsen
statements.quote_da: Undtagelsen ændrer dog ikke på, at den nye kvælstofregulering fortsat er altafgørende for at kunne håndtere de massive udfordringer, vi har med vores vandmiljø og i havene omkring os.
statements.gloss_en: The exemption does not, however, change the fact that the new nitrogen regulation remains all-decisive for handling the massive challenges we have with our water environment and in the seas around us.

statements.speaker: Christian Rabjerg Madsen
statements.quote_da: Vi gør ikke det her for sjov. Vi gør det for at tage ansvar for vores fjorde.
statements.gloss_en: We are not doing this for fun. We are doing it to take responsibility for our fjords.
statements.note: Third reading of L5 (gødskningsloven), passed 119–34.

statements.speaker: Christian Rabjerg Madsen
statements.quote_da: Man kan godt lade som om, at virkeligheden er noget andet. Men det er den ikke.
statements.gloss_en: One may well pretend that reality is something else. But it is not.
statements.note: Quoted in Altinget's headline and standfirst; the body of the article is behind a paywall, so the surrounding sentences were not verified.

statements.speaker: Christian Rabjerg Madsen
statements.quote_da: Når man taler om lappeløsninger, makværk og et uskønt forløb, så kaster man jord på noget af det fineste, som det danske folkestyre har præsteret. Nemlig den grønne trepart.
statements.gloss_en: When one speaks of patch-ups, botched work and an unlovely process, one throws dirt on some of the finest that Danish democracy has produced. Namely the green tripartite.

statements.speaker: Christian Rabjerg Madsen
statements.quote_da: Jeg synes, at vi oplever en stjernestund for folkestyret. DD og DF reducerer sig selv til partier for døde fisk og iltsvind, de bliver ved med at henvise til, at det er en rød regering, der står for det her forslag.
statements.gloss_en: I think we are experiencing a star moment for democracy. DD and DF reduce themselves to parties for dead fish and oxygen depletion; they keep pointing out that it is a red government behind this bill.

statements.speaker: Christian Rabjerg Madsen
statements.quote_da: At Inger Støjberg kalder lovbehandlingen for makværk og et uskønt forløb, må stå for egen regning, og det forstår jeg ikke. L5 følger den linje vi har lagt i aftalen om den grønne omstilling, som er indgået af en bred aftalekreds, hvor landbrugets parter også deltog.
statements.gloss_en: That Inger Støjberg calls the legislative process botched work and an unlovely process must stand on her own account, and I do not understand it. L5 follows the line we laid down in the agreement on the green transition, which was concluded by a broad circle in which agriculture's parties also took part.

statements.speaker: Finansministeriet, Miljøministeriet og Ministeriet for Fødevarer, Landbrug og Fiskeri (taskforce, FM formand)
statements.quote_da: Samlet set vurderer danske eksperter i fase I og det internationale ekspertpanel i fase II, at den danske tilgang til opgørelse af kvælstofindsatsbehovet er robust i forhold til opgørelse af kvælstofindsatsbehovet og bakker overordnet op om de valg og antagelser, der er foretaget i forbindelse med opgørelsen.
statements.gloss_en: Overall, Danish experts in phase I and the international expert panel in phase II assess that the Danish approach to computing the nitrogen indsatsbehov is robust with respect to computing the nitrogen indsatsbehov, and broadly endorse the choices and assumptions made in the computation.
statements.note: Second opinion, Sammenfatning, p. 14. This is the sentence most often invoked for the proposition that the basis is settled. It states robustness of method; it does not state the numerical accuracy of any individual catchment figure.

statements.speaker: Finansministeriet m.fl. (taskforce), refererende det internationale ekspertpanel (Herman et al. 2023)
statements.quote_da: Internationale eksperter konkluderer i fase II, at de marine modeller, der anvendes til opgørelse af referencer og målbelastninger er fit for purpose og afspejler de individuelle vandområder godt. Panelet ser ikke behov for yderligere modeludvikling eller for at forfine opgørelsen af kvælstofindsatsbehovet.
statements.gloss_en: International experts conclude in phase II that the marine models used for computing references and target loads are fit for purpose and reflect the individual water bodies well. The panel sees no need for further model development or for refining the computation of the nitrogen indsatsbehov.
statements.note: Second opinion, Sammenfatning, section 1.

statements.speaker: Miljøministeriet (boks 2, 'Miljøministeriets vurdering')
statements.quote_da: Det er Miljøministeriets vurdering, at Danmark ikke kan anvende artikel 4, stk. 4, til at udskyde opfyldelsen af vandrammedirektivets krav om opnåelse af god tilstand inden 22. december 2027, hvorfor de nødvendige indsatser skal være gennemført inden dette tidspunkt. [...] Det bemærkes, at EU-Domstolen ikke har taget direkte stilling til spørgsmålet.
statements.gloss_en: It is the Ministry of the Environment's assessment that Denmark cannot use Article 4(4) to postpone fulfilment of the Water Framework Directive's requirement of good status before 22 December 2027, and therefore the necessary measures must have been carried out before that date. [...] It is noted that the Court of Justice of the EU has not ruled directly on the question.
statements.note: Second opinion, Sammenfatning, boks 2. '[...]' skips two intervening sentences. The ministry asserts EU law leaves no discretion while noting there is no CJEU ruling on the point, and while the international panel (phase II) had found scope for the directive's exemption provisions.

statements.speaker: Miljøministeriet (kilde til boks 1)
statements.quote_da: I Danmark er indsatsbehovet for at opnå god økologisk tilstand i første omgang opgjort ved et kvælstofindsatsbehov, idet eutrofiering (forøget tilførsel af næringsstoffer til vandområder, som fører til øget algevækst og evt. iltsvind) på grund af forøget næringsstoftilførsel (primært kvælstof, men også fosfor) i store dele af landet aktuelt forhindrer den naturlige genopretning af havmiljøet.
statements.gloss_en: In Denmark the effort need for achieving good ecological status is in the first instance computed as a nitrogen effort need, since eutrophication (increased nutrient supply to water bodies, leading to increased algal growth and possibly oxygen depletion) due to increased nutrient supply (primarily nitrogen, but also phosphorus) currently prevents the natural restoration of the marine environment in large parts of the country.
statements.note: Second opinion, boks 1. Note 'evt. iltsvind' - hedged inside the technical document, unhedged in the ministerial press releases.

statements.speaker: Finansministeriet m.fl. (taskforce), refererende det internationale ekspertpanel
statements.quote_da: Det internationale panel konkluderer at der er andre presfaktorer, bortset fra næringsstoffer, der påvirker den økologiske tilstand i danske kystvande. Men der er dog lille eller ingen dokumentation for at en reduktion af disse presfaktorer kan erstatte reduktion af næringsstoffer.
statements.gloss_en: The international panel concludes that there are other pressure factors, apart from nutrients, that affect the ecological status of Danish coastal waters. But there is little or no documentation that a reduction of these pressure factors can replace a reduction of nutrients.

statements.speaker: Stephanie Lose
statements.quote_da: Det er en meget, meget hård regulering i dele af landet.
statements.gloss_en: It is a very, very hard regulation in parts of the country.
statements.note: Pull-quote visible above Altinget's paywall; the surrounding context was not verifiable.

statements.speaker: Carl Valentin
statements.quote_da: Det her er en noget nær perfekt situation. Endelig kommer den lovgivning, der beskytter vores fjorde mod iltsvind, fiskedød og landbrugets uhæmmede brug af gødning. Og ikke nok med det - nu giver vi også et pusterum til grøntsagsavlerne.
statements.gloss_en: This is a near-perfect situation. Finally comes the legislation that protects our fjords against oxygen depletion, fish death and agriculture's unrestrained use of fertiliser. And not only that — now we are also giving the vegetable growers a breathing space.
statements.note: Written statement. Direct policy -> outcome claim: the law 'protects the fjords against oxygen depletion'.

statements.speaker: Carl Valentin
statements.quote_da: Det er vildt vigtigt, at vi har et stærkt landbrug. Men balancen er tippet, når naturen dør, og det er det, som det her handler om.
statements.gloss_en: It is hugely important that we have a strong agriculture. But the balance has tipped when nature is dying, and that is what this is about.

statements.speaker: Carl Valentin
statements.quote_da: Vi står i en akut situation, fordi vi har forhalet problemmerne. Skiftende og uansvarlige regeringer har udskudt og udskudt beslutningen.
statements.gloss_en: We are in an acute situation because we have dragged out the problems. Successive and irresponsible governments have postponed and postponed the decision.
statements.note: Spelling 'problemmerne' as rendered by Maskinbladet.

statements.speaker: Carl Valentin
statements.quote_da: Det er muligt, at nogle flere skal stoppe med at dyrke deres jorder. Men jeg tror ikke, at det her vil påvirke beskæftigelsen synderligt.
statements.gloss_en: It is possible that some more will have to stop cultivating their land. But I do not think this will affect employment appreciably.

statements.speaker: Frederik Bloch Münster
statements.quote_da: Jeg synes i grunden, at det her er et godt lovforslag, fordi vi tager hånd om vores vandmiljø. Vi har ventet alt for længe, vi kan ikke vente længere.
statements.gloss_en: I basically think this is a good bill, because we are taking care of our water environment. We have waited far too long, we cannot wait any longer.
statements.note: TV 2 reports that he 'giver landbruget skylden for, at vandmiljøet flere steder i Danmark har det svært' — that framing is TV 2's, not a quote.

statements.speaker: Ole Birk Olesen
statements.quote_da: Meget af det, der bliver sagt fra landbrugskredse, passer desværre ikke.
statements.gloss_en: Much of what is said from agricultural circles unfortunately is not true.

statements.speaker: Pernille Vermund
statements.quote_da: Liberal Alliance og Danmarksdemokraterne er enige om meget. Vi er nok ikke helt enige om vores miljø- og naturpolitik, og det er så, som det er. Til gengæld kan jeg konstatere, at vi heller ikke er enige om, i hvilken grad man tager ansvar for det, som Inger Støjberg kalder rigtige mennesker.
statements.gloss_en: Liberal Alliance and the Denmark Democrats agree on much. We probably do not entirely agree on our environment and nature policy, and that is how it is. On the other hand I can note that we also do not agree on the degree to which one takes responsibility for what Inger Støjberg calls real people.

statements.speaker: Marie Bjerre
statements.quote_da: Vi er i Venstre ikke et protestparti. Vi sidder med ved forhandlingsbordet, og stemmer for - i hvert fald de fleste af os. Vi tager ansvar for kvælstofudledningen. Vi bliver nødt til at passe bedre på vores miljø, derfor stemmer vi for L5.
statements.gloss_en: In Venstre we are not a protest party. We sit at the negotiating table and vote in favour — at any rate most of us. We take responsibility for the nitrogen discharge. We have to look after our environment better, and that is why we vote for L5.

statements.speaker: Marie Bjerre
statements.quote_da: Jeg har ikke sovet særligt godt i nat, og det har jeg ikke gjort de sidste mange dage og uger. De fleste af jer kan se, at det her lovforslag ikke er nemt for mit parti og mine kolleger.
statements.gloss_en: I have not slept very well last night, and I have not done so for the last many days and weeks. Most of you can see that this bill is not easy for my party and my colleagues.
statements.note: Recorded for the account of Venstre's internal split; not itself a technical claim.

statements.speaker: Marie Bjerre
statements.quote_da: Politik er aldrig ligegyldigt. Så nej, jeg er ikke enig med ham i det. Loven bliver til noget alligevel, men det er klart, at det har et signal. Den her lovgivning har været svær for os.
statements.gloss_en: Politics is never irrelevant. So no, I do not agree with him on that. The law comes into being anyway, but clearly it sends a signal. This legislation has been hard for us.

statements.speaker: Marie Bjerre
statements.quote_da: Det her er et bevis på, at det nytter noget at sætte sig ved aftalebordet og forhandle.
statements.gloss_en: This is proof that it is worth sitting down at the negotiating table and negotiating.

statements.speaker: Inger Støjberg
statements.quote_da: Den er ikke ordentlig. Den er ikke gennemskuelig, og den er ikke gennemtænkt.
statements.gloss_en: It is not decent. It is not transparent, and it is not thought through.
statements.note: Ritzau reports she calls the law 'en omgang makværk'.

statements.speaker: Inger Støjberg
statements.quote_da: Men mens traktorerne rullede stille og roligt herude, mange af dem med flag på, og fødevareerhvervet råbte vagt i gevær, måtte man dog alligevel pludselig erkende, at der var dele af modellen, som ganske enkelt ikke hang sammen.
statements.gloss_en: But while the tractors rolled quietly out there, many of them with flags on, and the food industry raised the alarm, one nevertheless suddenly had to acknowledge that there were parts of the model that simply did not hold together.
statements.note: Refers to the last-minute exemption of vegetable growers.

statements.speaker: Inger Støjberg
statements.quote_da: Vi ser et uskønt forløb. Beslutningen som i dag bliver stemt igennem får enorme konsekvenser for danske landbrug, danske fødevarer og hele balancen i Danmark. Beslutningen indebærer enorm risiko og store tab af arbejdspladser i landdistrikterne.
statements.gloss_en: We are seeing an unlovely process. The decision voted through today will have enormous consequences for Danish agriculture, Danish food and the whole balance in Denmark. The decision entails enormous risk and large losses of jobs in the rural districts.

statements.speaker: Inger Støjberg
statements.quote_da: Vi vil også have en grøn omstilling om landbruget, vi vil også have rent drikkevand, rene fjorde og havmiljø, men omstillingen skal være baseret på sund fornuft.
statements.gloss_en: We also want a green transition of agriculture, we also want clean drinking water, clean fjords and marine environment, but the transition must be based on common sense.

statements.speaker: Inger Støjberg
statements.quote_da: Så er det en tilståelsessag om, at det, man er i gang med, er noget makværk. Det er et bevis på en mildest talt uskøn proces. Når man er nødt til at reparere og udskyde, så burde den naturlige reaktion ærligt talt være at standse op.
statements.gloss_en: Then it is a confession that what one is engaged in is botched work. It is proof of a, to put it mildly, unlovely process. When one has to repair and postpone, the natural reaction ought frankly to be to stop.

statements.speaker: Morten Messerschmidt
statements.quote_da: Det er en vigtig og følsom debat, vi har i dag. Det er forstemmende, hvordan de blå partier er i konflikt med hinanden. Jeg vil appelere til, at vi fremadrettet får koordineret bedre.
statements.gloss_en: It is an important and sensitive debate we are having today. It is dispiriting how the blue parties are in conflict with each other. I would appeal for us to coordinate better going forward.
statements.note: DF voted against L5. This quote is about bloc politics rather than the technical basis; no substantive DF claim about the nitrogen numbers was found in the sources searched.

statements.speaker: Franciska Rosenkilde
statements.quote_da: Vi når ikke at opfylde EU vandrammedirektiv med vedtagelsen af L5.
statements.gloss_en: We will not manage to fulfil the EU Water Framework Directive with the adoption of L5.
statements.note: Alternativet voted for the law while stating it is insufficient.

statements.speaker: Radikale Venstre (partisvar; partiets miljø- og naturordfører Katrine Robsøe blandt respondenterne)
statements.quote_da: Vi ønsker en stærk kobling mellem forskning, myndigheder og praksis, hvor ny viden hurtigt omsættes til bedre regulering. Grøn Trepart skal gennemføres på et vidensbaseret grundlag. Det kræver først og fremmest, at aktørerne i Grøn Trepart lytter til eksperter og tager den nyeste viden om bl.a. kvælstofindsats, drikkevand, biodiversitet mv. med i arbejdet med at udtage landbrugsjord. Det er ikke konstruktivt for samarbejdet i den grønne trepart, når fx landbrugserhvervet gang på gang sår tvivl om myndigheder og fageksperters analyser og rapporter.
statements.gloss_en: We want a strong coupling between research, authorities and practice, where new knowledge is quickly converted into better regulation. The Green Tripartite must be implemented on a knowledge-based foundation. That above all requires the actors in the Green Tripartite to listen to experts and bring the latest knowledge on, among other things, the nitrogen effort, drinking water and biodiversity into the work of taking farmland out of production. It is not constructive for the cooperation in the green tripartite when, for example, the agricultural industry again and again sows doubt about authorities' and expert specialists' analyses and reports.
statements.note: Written party answer to DM Bio's pre-election questionnaire, published ahead of the 24 March 2026 general election. Casts doubt-raising about the analyses as an obstacle to cooperation rather than as a technical question.

statements.speaker: Radikale Venstre (partisvar)
statements.quote_da: Men frivillige aftaler gør det ikke alene – så kommer Grøn Trepart aldrig i mål. Derfor ser vi et behov for at stramme kvælstofreguleringen, forbyde brugen af sprøjtemidler over vores drikkevand og øge klimaafgiften på landbruget. Pisk og gulerod skal følges ad, og lige nu har vi ikke den rette balance.
statements.gloss_en: But voluntary agreements do not do it alone — then the Green Tripartite will never reach its goal. Therefore we see a need to tighten the nitrogen regulation, ban the use of pesticides over our drinking water and raise the climate levy on agriculture. Stick and carrot must go together, and right now we do not have the right balance.

statements.speaker: Socialdemokratiet (partisvar; miljø- og naturordfører Thomas Monberg blandt respondenterne)
statements.quote_da: Ja! Vi er meget stolte af Grøn Trepart, som er helt central for omlægningen af et meget opdyrket Danmark til et land med langt mere natur og skov.
statements.gloss_en: Yes! We are very proud of the Green Tripartite, which is absolutely central to converting a heavily cultivated Denmark into a country with far more nature and forest.

statements.speaker: Venstre (partisvar; miljø- og naturordfører Erling Bonnesen blandt respondenterne)
statements.quote_da: Vi bakker 100 procent op om Grøn Trepart, og implementeringen af trepartsaftalen fortsætter også efter et folketingsvalg. Der skal i de kommende 15 år anvendes mere end 50 milliarder offentlige midler og fondsmidler på Grøn Trepart, som flertallet af partierne i det nuværende Folketing står bag, og hvor op mod 15 pct. af landbrugsjorden skal udtages til vådområder og skovrejsning.
statements.gloss_en: We back the Green Tripartite 100 percent, and the implementation of the tripartite agreement continues also after a general election. Over the coming 15 years more than 50 billion in public and foundation funds are to be spent on the Green Tripartite, which the majority of parties in the current Folketing stand behind, and where up to 15 percent of farmland is to be taken out for wetlands and afforestation.

statements.speaker: SF (partisvar; ordførere Carl Valentin og Marianne Bigum blandt respondenterne)
statements.quote_da: Der er dog et akut behov for at få sat midler af til en øget kontrol med, om landbruget efterlever den nye kvælstofregulering.
statements.gloss_en: There is, however, an acute need to set aside funds for increased control of whether agriculture complies with the new nitrogen regulation.

statements.speaker: Enhedslisten (partisvar; miljø- og naturordfører Leila Stockmarr blandt respondenterne)
statements.quote_da: Enhedslisten er ikke med i aftalen om Grøn Trepart, men har deltaget i flere af de lokale grønne treparter rundt omkring i Danmark. Vi mener, at det er en stor udfordring, at implementeringen af aftalen i så høj grad er afhængig af, at landmænd frivilligt vil indgå i ordninger om at udtage arealer, rejse skov og genskabe natur.
statements.gloss_en: The Red-Green Alliance is not part of the Green Tripartite agreement, but has taken part in several of the local green tripartites around Denmark. We think it is a major challenge that implementation of the agreement depends to such a degree on farmers voluntarily entering schemes to take land out, plant forest and recreate nature.
statements.note: EL nevertheless voted for L5 on 3 September 2026.

statements.speaker: Alternativet (partisvar; ordfører Torsten Gejl blandt respondenterne)
statements.quote_da: Det mener vi ikke er muligt i dag, da de politiske rammer ikke er stærke nok. Vi kan i den nuværende aftale ikke se, hvordan en tilstrækkelig kvælstofreduktion fra landbruget er mulig, når så meget er afhængigt af frivillige aftaler, der har fejlet gennem 20 år.
statements.gloss_en: We do not think that is possible today, since the political framework is not strong enough. In the current agreement we cannot see how a sufficient nitrogen reduction from agriculture is possible, when so much depends on voluntary agreements that have failed for 20 years.

statements.speaker: Maria Reumert Gjerding
statements.quote_da: Det her er et stort og vigtigt skridt mod at få livet tilbage i vores fjorde og kyster. År efter år har vi set forfærdeligt iltsvind og fedtemøg. Skal havet have en chance, må landbrugets kvælstofforurening ned. Derfor er vi glade for, at et bredt flertal nu stiller markant skærpede krav til udledningerne.
statements.gloss_en: This is a big and important step towards getting life back in our fjords and coasts. Year after year we have seen terrible oxygen depletion and 'fat muck'. If the sea is to have a chance, agriculture's nitrogen pollution must come down. That is why we are glad that a broad majority is now setting markedly tightened requirements on the discharges.
statements.note: Gjerding later became a minister (Ministeriet for Natur og Dyrevelfærd portfolio area) in 2026; at the time of this statement she was DN president.

statements.speaker: Maria Reumert Gjerding
statements.quote_da: Det bliver helt afgørende, at reguleringen faktisk får landmænd til at omlægge de jorde, der forurener mest, og det er der ikke skabt tilstrækkelig sikkerhed for.
statements.gloss_en: It becomes absolutely decisive that the regulation actually gets farmers to convert the soils that pollute most, and sufficient certainty of that has not been created.

statements.speaker: Danmarks Naturfredningsforening (kampagneside 'Kvælstof')
statements.quote_da: Landbruget står for størstedelen af kvælstofudledningerne. Hele 69 procent af den kvælstof, der ender i vores fjorde og indre farvande, stammer fra landbrugets brug af gødning.
statements.gloss_en: Agriculture accounts for the greater part of nitrogen discharges. A full 69 percent of the nitrogen that ends up in our fjords and inner waters comes from agriculture's use of fertiliser.
statements.note: The 69-69.6 % figure is a modelled source apportionment: diffuse agricultural load is obtained as a residual after subtracting modelled natural background and reported point sources, then routed through a modelled retention map. Stated here as a fact about what 'ender i' the water. Page undated at time of capture.

statements.speaker: Lars Midtiby
statements.quote_da: Det var en bunden opgave at iværksætte alle tiltag, der skal sikre et godt vandmiljø, senest i 2027. Et af de vigtigste værktøjer vælger regeringen desværre nu at udskyde. Det er dybt skuffende og dårligt nyt for vores fjorde og kyster, og ikke mindst et brud på den grønne trepartsaftale.
statements.gloss_en: It was an obligatory task to launch all measures securing a good water environment by 2027 at the latest. One of the most important tools the government now unfortunately chooses to postpone. That is deeply disappointing and bad news for our fjords and coasts, and not least a breach of the green tripartite agreement.

statements.speaker: Christian Fromberg
statements.role: Kampagneleder for landbrug, natur og skov, Greenpeace Danmark
statements.quote_da: Det er optur at der ligger en aftale, der nedbringer landbrugets forurening med kvælstof, og det vil kunne mærkes på livet i vores fjorde og langs vores kyster. Men regeringen beholder fløjlshandskerne på og er stadig langt fra at stille strenge nok krav til at få landbrugets forurening langt nok ned. Det er ikke godt nok i 2025.
statements.gloss_en: It is a lift that there is an agreement reducing agriculture's nitrogen pollution, and it will be felt in the life in our fjords and along our coasts. But the government keeps the velvet gloves on and is still far from setting strict enough requirements to get agriculture's pollution far enough down. That is not good enough in 2025.

statements.speaker: Christian Fromberg
statements.quote_da: Gennem 40 år har skiftende regeringer lavet den ene aftale efter den anden, som skulle nedbringe landbrugets forurening af kvælstof. De har gang efter gang lidt skibbrud, fordi man har satset på frivillige aftaler med landbruget. Derfor er det lidt af en joke, at man stadig i høj grad satser på frivillighed for at sænke den massive udledning af kvælstof.
statements.gloss_en: Over 40 years successive governments have made one agreement after another meant to reduce agriculture's nitrogen pollution. Time after time they have foundered, because voluntary agreements with agriculture were relied upon. That is why it is something of a joke that voluntariness is still largely relied upon to lower the massive nitrogen discharge.

statements.speaker: Greenpeace Danmark (pressemeddelelse)
statements.quote_da: Regeringen arbejder ud fra et estimat om, at kvælstofudledningen skal nedbringes med 13.780 ton. Den nye regulering kan dermed garantere op til 52 procent af vejen til det mål. [...] Eksperter peger imidlertid på, at det reelle behov for at sænke kvælstofudledningerne er på den gode side af 20.000 ton.
statements.gloss_en: The government works from an estimate that nitrogen discharge must be reduced by 13,780 tonnes. The new regulation can thereby guarantee up to 52 percent of the way to that target. [...] Experts point out, however, that the real need to lower nitrogen discharges is on the high side of 20,000 tonnes.
statements.note: Elision skips one intervening sentence. Greenpeace calls the denominator 'et estimat' here; its 2026 material states the 69.6 % share without qualification (gp-2026-08-25-696).

statements.speaker: Greenpeace Danmark (artikel)
statements.quote_da: Årtiers kvælstofforurening fra det industrielle landbrug har skabt voldsomt iltsvind og livløse danske fjorde.
statements.gloss_en: Decades of nitrogen pollution from industrial agriculture have created violent oxygen depletion and lifeless Danish fjords.

statements.speaker: Greenpeace Danmark (artikel)
statements.quote_da: Mere præcist viser de seneste tal, at landbruget står for 69,6 % af kvælstoftilførslen til kystområderne, mens den politiske regulering halter alvorligt bagud.
statements.gloss_en: More precisely, the latest figures show that agriculture accounts for 69.6 % of the nitrogen supply to coastal areas, while political regulation lags seriously behind.
statements.note: 'Mere præcist ... viser de seneste tal' presents a modelled residual to one decimal place. Whitespace around ' , ' in the source HTML normalised.

statements.speaker: Torben Kaas
statements.quote_da: Den nye kvælstofaftale er et stort og nødvendigt skridt for havmiljøet. Vores fjorde og indre farvande lider under årtiers alt for høje kvælstofudledninger fra landbruget, som den nye regulering nu tager alvorligt livtag med. Det er første gang, vi ser en model, der for alvor kan gøre en forskel.
statements.gloss_en: The new nitrogen agreement is a big and necessary step for the marine environment. Our fjords and inner waters suffer from decades of far too high nitrogen discharges from agriculture, which the new regulation now seriously grapples with. It is the first time we see a model that can really make a difference.

statements.speaker: Mads Christoffersen
statements.quote_da: Havet har i årevis stået med ryggen mod muren. Med den her lov tages der nu et vigtigt skridt for at give livet tilbage under havoverfladen.
statements.gloss_en: The sea has for years stood with its back to the wall. With this law an important step is now taken to give life back beneath the sea surface.

statements.speaker: Danmarks Naturfredningsforening og Danmarks Sportsfiskerforbund (optælling)
statements.quote_da: Indtil videre har 38 af Danmarks 108 kystvande været ramt af iltsvind i 2026. På samme tidspunkt i 2024 og 2025 var der registreret iltsvind i henholdsvis 34 og 33 kystvande.
statements.gloss_en: So far 38 of Denmark's 108 coastal waters have been hit by oxygen depletion in 2026. At the same time in 2024 and 2025 oxygen depletion had been registered in 34 and 33 coastal waters respectively.
statements.note: Based on SGAV data as of 27 August 2026. This is a count of monitored occurrences and is closer to a measurement than the load-share figures.

statements.speaker: Søren Søndergaard
statements.quote_da: L&F ser med dyb bekymring på aftalen. Den model, som politikerne nu har valgt, er en model, der rammer landbruget, fødevaresektoren og virksomhederne hårdt. Det er endnu en politisk aftale, der betyder langt hårdere restriktioner, end der blev forudsat med den oprindelige trepartsaftale, som L&F indgik. Tilmed også hårdere end i den politiske aftale, som politikerne vedtog i november 2024. Det er unødvendigt og uforståeligt.
statements.gloss_en: L&F views the agreement with deep concern. The model politicians have now chosen is a model that hits agriculture, the food sector and the companies hard. It is yet another political agreement meaning far harder restrictions than were presupposed in the original tripartite agreement L&F entered. Indeed harder even than in the political agreement politicians adopted in November 2024. It is unnecessary and incomprehensible.

statements.speaker: Søren Søndergaard
statements.quote_da: Som vi har sagt mange gange, havde vi hellere set, at man indførte en ren VISA-model, og dermed undgik at skulle bruge meget usikre data i reguleringen.
statements.gloss_en: As we have said many times, we would rather have seen a pure VISA model introduced, thereby avoiding having to use very uncertain data in the regulation.

statements.speaker: Søren Søndergaard
statements.quote_da: Til trods for meget klare advarsler fra et samlet erhverv og en række andre erhvervsorganisationer, samt et meget klart ønske om ikke at fordele reguleringstryk efter de usikre modelberegnede retentionskort må vi konstatere, at nogle politiske partier i forhandlingslokalet har haft et selvstændigt ønske om at stække landbruget og fødevareproduktionens udvikling.
statements.gloss_en: Despite very clear warnings from a united industry and a number of other business organisations, and a very clear wish not to distribute regulatory pressure according to the uncertain model-computed retention maps, we must note that some political parties in the negotiating room have had an independent wish to clip the wings of agriculture and food production's development.
statements.note: Directly contests using model-computed retention maps to set individual holdings' regulatory pressure.

statements.speaker: Landbrug & Fødevarer (redaktionel indledning på foreningens nyhed)
statements.quote_da: Den nye kvælstofaftale skærper restriktionerne udover det, der blev forudsat med den oprindelige trepartsaftale, som L&F indgik i juni 2024. Usikre modelberegnede retentionskort spiller en rolle i aftalen, der reelt vil få konsekvenser for landmænd allerede fra næste år.
statements.gloss_en: The new nitrogen agreement tightens the restrictions beyond what was presupposed in the original tripartite agreement L&F entered in June 2024. Uncertain model-computed retention maps play a role in the agreement, which will in reality have consequences for farmers already from next year.

statements.speaker: Søren Søndergaard
statements.quote_da: Aftalen betyder, at nogle landmænd i fremtiden får for mange kvælstofkvoter og flere får alt for få. For den enkelte landmand bliver det som at trække sine produktionsvilkår i en tombola, uden mulighed for at klage hvis udledningskvoten er en ”nitte”, som tvinger en til at opgive sin produktion.
statements.gloss_en: The agreement means that some farmers in future will get too many nitrogen quotas and more will get far too few. For the individual farmer it becomes like drawing his production conditions in a tombola, with no possibility of appeal if the discharge quota is a 'blank' that forces one to give up production.

statements.speaker: Søren Søndergaard
statements.quote_da: Det er helt urimelige vilkår og grundlæggende uanstændigt at der her i december måned 2025 laves så markante ændringer i et helt erhvervs rammevilkår med ekstremt kort varsel.
statements.gloss_en: These are completely unreasonable conditions and fundamentally improper, that here in December 2025 such marked changes are made to an entire industry's framework conditions at extremely short notice.

statements.speaker: Søren Søndergaard
statements.quote_da: Regeringen er ved at undergrave den grønne trepart og dansk fødevareproduktion.
statements.gloss_en: The government is undermining the green tripartite and Danish food production.
statements.note: Said from the podium at L&F's stormøde in Odense.

statements.speaker: Søren Søndergaard
statements.quote_da: Det er en svær dag for dansk landbrug. Folketinget tager nu et stort skridt i retning af at gøre det sværere og dyrere at producere fødevarer i Danmark. På trods af vores markante advarsler. [...] Nu starter næste halvleg. For nogle af de forudsætningsbrud, I har udsat den oprindelige grønne trepart for, kan og skal stadig fikses i udfoldelsen af det her makværk. Alternativet bliver ikke til at bære, og det er alene jeres ansvar.
statements.gloss_en: It is a hard day for Danish agriculture. The Folketing now takes a big step towards making it harder and more expensive to produce food in Denmark. Despite our emphatic warnings. [...] Now the second half begins. Some of the breaches of premise you have subjected the original green tripartite to can and must still be fixed in the unfolding of this botched work. The alternative will not be bearable, and it is your responsibility alone.
statements.note: Elision marks the break between two separately quoted paragraphs in TV 2's rendering of the L&F press release.

statements.speaker: Claus Neergaard
statements.role: Formand, Landøkonomisk Selskab; planteavler, Gunderslevholm Gods
statements.quote_da: Men allerværst er der den forvaltningsmæssige og retssikkerhedsmæssige udfordring i, at modeller fylder så meget. NUAR-rapporten angiver selv en meget lav udsagnskraft, og det er meget betænkeligt med dens rækkevidde.
statements.gloss_en: But worst of all there is the administrative and legal-certainty challenge in models filling so much. The NUAR report itself states a very low explanatory power, and that is very worrying given its reach.
statements.note: Objection that the regulating model's own reported explanatory power is low relative to the decisions taken on it. Date is the article's publication date.

statements.speaker: Claus Neergaard
statements.quote_da: Tænk, hvis de i øvrigt EU-krævede målinger på et tidspunkt viser, at en bedrift er lukket og tømt for egenkapital på et helt forkert grundlag. [...] Men hvordan vil myndighederne forholde sig, hvis fysiske målinger på et tidspunkt tilsidesætter modeller? Det kan på sigt udløse giganterstatninger for staten.
statements.gloss_en: Imagine if the measurements otherwise required by the EU at some point show that a holding has been closed and emptied of equity on a wholly wrong basis. [...] But how will the authorities respond if physical measurements at some point override models? That could in time trigger giant compensation claims against the state.
statements.note: Frames the model output as something physical measurement could later contradict.

statements.speaker: Claus Neergaard
statements.quote_da: Jeg kan kun endnu engang opfordre til en »timeout« i indførelsen af ny kvælstof-reguleringsmodel, indtil et betryggende fagligt grundlag er tilvejebragt.
statements.gloss_en: I can only once again call for a 'timeout' in the introduction of the new nitrogen regulation model, until a reassuring technical basis has been provided.

statements.speaker: Leif Wilson Laustsen
statements.quote_da: Det er svært at forstå, at vi i 2026 vil regulere dansk landbrug efter beregninger af, hvor meget kvælstof der løb ud i havet for 6.000 år siden. Dengang var Danmark dækket af skov, og landbruget, som vi kender det, eksisterede ikke. Alligevel skal de tal være med til at afgøre, hvor meget der kan produceres på danske marker i dag. Folketingets partier bør som minimum kræve svar på, hvorfor netop dette referencegrundlag er det rigtige, og om reguleringen holder i forhold til EU-retten, før de vedtager loven.
statements.gloss_en: It is hard to understand that in 2026 we want to regulate Danish agriculture according to calculations of how much nitrogen ran out into the sea 6,000 years ago. Back then Denmark was covered in forest, and agriculture as we know it did not exist. Nevertheless those figures are to help decide how much can be produced on Danish fields today. The Folketing's parties should at minimum demand answers as to why precisely this reference basis is the right one, and whether the regulation holds up against EU law, before they adopt the law.
statements.note: Attacks the reference-condition modelling that sets MAI. Date approximate: the release states it followed the first reading of the gødskningslov ('I sidste uge'); first reading was 13 August 2026.

statements.speaker: Peder Tuborgh
statements.quote_da: Hold nu op med at tale om udvikling. I udvikler ikke landbruget. I afvikler landbruget. Og I har i hvert fald afviklet fødevareministeriet.
statements.gloss_en: Do stop talking about development. You are not developing agriculture. You are dismantling agriculture. And you have at any rate dismantled the food ministry.

statements.speaker: Rasmus Prehn
statements.quote_da: I Økologisk Landsforening ønsker vi maksimalt pres på udledning af kvælstof til vandmiljøet. Derfor har vi arbejdet for, at konventionelle landbrug ikke skal have mulighed for at købe de kvælstofudledningskvoter, som økologer ikke bruger, fordi de udleder langt mindre kvælstof. Det var der ikke stemning for blandt de politiske partier, og det ærgrer vi os over.
statements.gloss_en: In the Organic Association we want maximum pressure on nitrogen discharge to the water environment. That is why we have worked for conventional farms not to be able to buy the nitrogen discharge quotas that organic farmers do not use, because they discharge far less nitrogen. There was no appetite for that among the political parties, and we regret that.
statements.note: Prehn is a former Socialdemokratiet food minister, here speaking for Økologisk Landsforening.

statements.speaker: GEUS og Aarhus Universitet (pressemeddelelse)
statements.quote_da: Kvælstofretentionen kan i praksis ikke måles direkte. Forskere fra De Nationale Geologiske Undersøgelser for Danmark og Grønland (GEUS) og Aarhus Universitet har derfor udviklet en model, hvor beregningerne bygger på data for kvælstofbidrag fra punktkilder samt natur- og landbrugsarealer i kombination med målinger af kvælstof i vandløb fra det nationale overvågningsprogram (NOVANA).
statements.gloss_en: Nitrogen retention cannot in practice be measured directly. Researchers from GEUS and Aarhus University have therefore developed a model, where the computations build on data for nitrogen contributions from point sources and from nature and agricultural areas, combined with measurements of nitrogen in streams from the national monitoring programme (NOVANA).
statements.note: The producing institutions state that the regulated quantity is not directly measurable. Compare mgtp-2025-12-03-c, which describes updates to the related model output as 'nye målinger'.

statements.speaker: Anker Lajer Højberg
statements.quote_da: Retentionskortet er et beslutningsstøtteværktøj – ikke en facitliste. Der er stadig områder, hvor datagrundlaget og vidensniveauet er begrænset, og derfor skal anvendelsen af kortet altid vurderes i den konkrete kontekst.
statements.gloss_en: The retention map is a decision-support tool — not an answer key. There are still areas where the data basis and knowledge level are limited, and therefore the use of the map must always be assessed in the concrete context.
statements.note: Said by the retention map's project leader on 27 August 2025, three months before the 3 December 2025 agreement made the map a basis for per-holding quotas.

statements.speaker: Hanne Lakkenborg Kristensen
statements.quote_da: Regnemodellen er lavet til de store landbrugsafgrøder som for eksempel korn. Så den passer ikke til grøntsager. Den er simpelthen ikke blevet testet og holdt op imod den viden, vi har om grøntsager.
statements.gloss_en: The calculation model is made for the big agricultural crops such as grain. So it does not fit vegetables. It simply has not been tested and held up against the knowledge we have about vegetables.

statements.speaker: DR Verificerer (redaktionel tekst)
statements.quote_da: Ja, det er videnskabeligt dokumenteret i rapporter fra Aarhus Universitet, at hovedparten af forureningen af farvandene fra kvælstof kommer fra landbruget. [...] Ifølge de tal står landbruget for 69,6 procent af det kvælstof, der udvaskes fra Danmark til havene.
statements.gloss_en: Yes, it is scientifically documented in reports from Aarhus University that the greater part of the nitrogen pollution of the waters comes from agriculture. [...] According to those figures agriculture accounts for 69.6 percent of the nitrogen leached from Denmark to the seas.
statements.note: Elision skips two intervening paragraphs. Source is the public broadcaster's fact-checking desk, not a politician; included because this framing is reproduced in the political debate.

statements.speaker: Maria Andersen
statements.quote_da: Men naturen er jo ikke opdelt i firkanter, så der vil altid være en usikkerhed ved den slags kort. Hvis det skulle være mere præcist, ville det kræve, at der blev sat en måler på hver eneste mark og hvert eneste dræn, og selv der ville der fortsat være en vis usikkerhed. Og så ville det være ekstremt dyrt og omstændeligt.
statements.gloss_en: But nature is not divided into squares, so there will always be an uncertainty with that kind of map. If it were to be more precise it would require putting a meter on every single field and every single drain, and even then there would still be a certain uncertainty. And it would be extremely expensive and cumbersome.
statements.note: Appears in the same DR article as the 69.6 % statement recorded under dr-verificerer-2026-09-03-a.

statements.speaker: DANVA (brancheorganisation for vandselskaber)
statements.quote_da: Ifølge data fra Miljøstyrelsen og Aarhus Universitet kommer 91,7 % af al kvælstofudledning fra diffuse kilder, hvor landbruget alene står for 69,6 %. Disse diffuse kilder omfatter blandt andet udvaskning fra marker, hvor gødning anvendes, samt naturlige baggrundskilder, som bidrager med 22,1 %.
statements.gloss_en: According to data from the Environmental Protection Agency and Aarhus University, 91.7 % of all nitrogen discharge comes from diffuse sources, where agriculture alone accounts for 69.6 %. These diffuse sources include leaching from fields where fertiliser is used, as well as natural background sources, which contribute 22.1 %.
statements.note: The 22.1 % 'naturlig baggrund' is itself a model output; agriculture's 69.6 % is the remainder after subtracting it and the reported point sources. Whitespace around ' % . ' in the source HTML normalised. Precise publication month not given on the page as captured.

statements.speaker: Europa-Kommissionen (Repræsentationen i Danmark)
statements.quote_da: Europa-Kommissionen har besluttet at indlede traktatbrudsprocedurer ved at sende åbningsskrivelser til Danmark (INFR(2025)2209), Italien (INFR(2025)2207) og Luxembourg (INFR(2025)2216) på grund af manglende korrekt gennemførelse af vandrammedirektivet (direktiv 2000/60/EF), herunder forpligtelsen til at foretage regelmæssige revisioner af vandtilladelser.
statements.gloss_en: The European Commission has decided to open infringement procedures by sending letters of formal notice to Denmark (INFR(2025)2209), Italy (INFR(2025)2207) and Luxembourg (INFR(2025)2216) due to failure to correctly implement the Water Framework Directive (Directive 2000/60/EC), including the obligation to carry out regular reviews of water permits.
statements.note: This infringement case concerns review of water abstraction permits, not the nitrogen indsatsbehov. Whitespace inside ' ( direktiv 2000/60/EF ) ' in the source HTML normalised.

public_positions.position: Owns the agreement through two successive ministers (Jeppe Bruus to mid-2026, then Christian Rabjerg Madsen). Frames the regulation as necessary to restore life in the fjords, treats the technical basis as settled, and rejects calls for further review.

Formally in the agreement and voted for L5, while its own ministers described the regulation as 'meget, meget hård' in parts of the country. Five MPs (Søren Gade, Anni Matthiesen, Preben Bang Henriksen, Peter Juel-Jensen, Amanda Heitmann) broke the party line. Venstre's line is that participation buys influence: it claims credit for the vegetable exemption and for 'åbenhed og adgang til efterprøvning af data'.
Party to the December 2025 agreement as a government party and to 'Aftale om Implementering af et Grønt Danmark'. No separate M statement on the nitrogen numbers was found in the sources searched.

Pushed for a stricter distribution targeting the most polluting soils; credited together with RV by Danmarks Sportsfiskerforbund for raising the reduction level. States the law 'beskytter vores fjorde mod iltsvind, fiskedød og landbrugets uhæmmede brug af gødning', and calls for funds for enforcement.
Defends participation as the responsible course and attacks DD/DF for standing outside. Ole Birk Olesen states from the rostrum that much of what agricultural circles say is untrue.
Supports the bill on water-environment grounds and blames delay: 'Vi har ventet alt for længe, vi kan ikke vente længere'.
Supports the framework but wants the regulation tightened, voluntary instruments supplemented, and treats questioning of the authorities' analyses by the agricultural industry as unconstructive.
Not a party to the Green Tripartite; criticises its reliance on voluntary land conversion and wants the state and municipalities to buy land directly. Voted for L5 nonetheless.

Says the framework cannot deliver a sufficient nitrogen reduction while it depends on voluntary agreements 'der har fejlet gennem 20 år', and stated in the chamber that L5 will not meet the Water Framework Directive. Voted for it anyway.

Opposes: calls the law 'makværk', not transparent and not thought through; predicts large job losses in rural districts; treats the last-minute vegetable exemption as proof the model does not hold together. Says it wants a green transition 'baseret på sund fornuft'.

Opposes and voted against; Messerschmidt's public statements on the day focus on bloc coordination rather than the technical basis. No substantive DF claim about the nitrogen figures was found in the sources searched.
Voted against L5. No statement located in the sources searched.

public_positions.in_agreement: part of the 2024 Green Tripartite, not of the Dec 2025 distribution deal
public_positions.position: Signed the June 2024 Green Tripartite; opposes the December 2025 distribution model as harder than what was presupposed, and objects specifically to distributing regulatory pressure by 'usikre modelberegnede retentionskort'. Wanted a pure VISA model and a delay.

Welcomes the December 2025 agreement as 'et stort og vigtigt skridt', but wanted quotas targeted harder at the most polluting soils and later called the June 2026 deferral of the kvælstofhammer to 2028 a breach of the tripartite agreement.

Says the agreements go nowhere near far enough: the reduction target itself is too low (cites experts at over 20,000 t against the government's 13,780 t estimate), and too much still rests on voluntariness.
Wants maximum pressure on nitrogen discharge but objects to conventional farms being able to buy organic farmers' unused discharge quotas.

Demands that the Folketing account for the reference basis before adopting the law, arguing that the environmental target is set at c. year 1900 conditions while agriculture's required load corresponds to c. 6,000 years earlier, and questioning whether that is compatible with EU law.
